verdict.rationale: Simular documents a REST API, Python SDK and MCP server that give developers 'the same autonomous computer'. The API covers sending tasks, streaming progress, answering approvals and listing machines, so the core agent loop is programmable. But UI-parity is not shown for scheduling, saving and sharing skills, workflow templates, notification settings or BYOD device management, and no public OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. Missing for 10: documented API parity for schedules, skills management, templates and notifications; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; independent confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: gives developers, their code and their coding agents the same autonomous computer through a REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server.
`GET /v1/agents/events` streams progress; `POST /v1/agents/approve` answers an approval request; `GET /v1/agents/machines` lists your computers.
Developers can drive Sai from their own code or coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) with the Sai API: send a task in plain language, and Sai completes it on a cloud Windows computer.
